title: Show login option first on application startup

requirements.summary: Present login/authentication option immediately when users first access the application, before showing any other content or features
acceptanceCriteria: When users access the application for the first time, they see a login prompt or authentication interface before the main content
The login interface is prominently displayed and clearly guides users to authenticate via Internet Identity
After successful authentication, users proceed to the main application content (doubts feed, role setup, etc.)
Unauthenticated users cannot access main application features without logging in first

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated login screen component that displays prominently when users are not authenticated. Include branding elements, a clear call-to-action for Internet Identity login, and brief explanation of the platform. Use the authorization component to handle Internet Identity authentication. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Modify the root App component to check authentication status first. If the user is not authenticated (no identity from useInternetIdentity), render the LoginScreen component instead of the router. Only render the TanStack Router and application routes after successful authentication. This ensures unauthenticated users see the login screen before any application content.

Update the Layout component to handle the authenticated state more gracefully. Since authentication now happens before routing, ensure the Layout assumes the user is authenticated and focuses on profile setup flow (RoleSetupModal) and navigation without redundant authentication checks.
